review_batches.context: Xiujian's final counterattacks and Seven Flashes chants, followed by Clovis's opening dodge/light-damage alternatives. Read 700-1064 with the complete element cycle and surrounding Clovis lines.
review_batches.decisions: Keep all five elements and both celestial terms, every transformation in the chant, the full glossary move name and short segmented call. Retain Baldock spelling and two divisions in Clovis's boast. No shortening for fit; English layout and insertion are separate. Source move-call fragments and pauses are intentional.

row_decisions.battle.o05d2b.p00.l01: Short segmented Dragon Command Rift Breaker call belongs to the full glossary move Seven Flashes: Dragon Command Rift Breaker.
row_decisions.battle.o05d6c.p00.l00: Five Elements and Two Heavens is an editorial rendering of the chant's collective phrase. The following calls explicitly enumerate Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water, Sun and Moon.
row_decisions.battle.o05dd5.p00.l00: Keep all seven items in source order, including Metal rather than Gold. Sun/Moon are the chant's imagery, not an asserted account of Agarthia's astronomical bodies.
row_decisions.battle.o05eef.p00.l00: Preserve all stages of the fictional chant: Sun dims/Moon appears; Wood burns/Fire; Fire ends/Earth; Earth gathers/Metal; Metal bears dew/Water; Water sources Wood; Moon turns to Sun. Do not replace with a generic element slogan.
row_decisions.battle.o0607a.p00.l00: Clovis's boor/manners taunt is deliberately flippant. He is evading a hostile approach, not literally running an invitation system.
row_decisions.battle.o0609d.p00.l00: Flirtatious embrace metaphor retains its stated restriction to beautiful women; don't invent physical contact or a specific partner.
row_decisions.battle.o06184.p00.l00: Explicit two additional military divisions retained as an exaggerated boast, not a count of actual enemies.
row_decisions.battle.o061f0.p00.l00: Know your limits localizes the taunt about one's own capacity. It is not a literal container or technical mech capacity.
row_decisions.battle.o0621a.p00.l00: Clovis calls the attack a joke and asks if it was meant to finish him; preserve the sarcasm.

review_batches.context: Clovis's light-to-severe damage alternatives and start of critical-damage banter. Read physical rows 1030-1374, including complete prior/following spans and the transition to Fain.
review_batches.decisions: Preserve flippant jokes, self-assessment, damage uncertainty, explicit decapitation taunt and the difference between a suggested pullback and an actual defeat. Keep every formatting token and timing blank. Interjections, source omissions, idioms trailing off and physical continuations remain deliberate fragments.

row_decisions.battle.o0631f.p00.l00: The reflective wording means Clovis should not underestimate the opponent, unlike his earlier don't underestimate Baldock order. Restore the first-person subject.
row_decisions.battle.o06333.p00.l00: Deliberately unfinished disbelief at the weapon being used; do not invent a named weapon or missing conclusion.
row_decisions.battle.o06393.p00.l00: Both women's tears and cats are his stated weaknesses; keep both quoted comic categories rather than making a literal combat vulnerability rule.
row_decisions.battle.o0651f.p00.l00: Clovis attributes the hit to his own guard dropping; do not blame the enemy for carelessness.
row_decisions.battle.o06657.p00.l00: Little hits add up localizes the dust-piling proverb in the damage context while retaining its trailing cadence.
row_decisions.battle.o066a7.p00.l01: The machine's parts are metaphorically screaming. Do not invent injured passengers or a specific failed subsystem.
row_decisions.battle.o0676e.p00.l01: Cheating is Clovis's accusation at the surprising attack, not a claim that the game detected cheating.
row_decisions.battle.o06820.p00.l00: Conditional survival credit goes to Baldock; do not state an actual death or machine loss.
row_decisions.battle.o0685e.p00.l01: Keep the explicit cut-my-head-off challenge without softening or adding visual injury.
row_decisions.battle.o0695b.p00.l00: Skin of my teeth is the natural equivalent of the source's one-layer-of-neck-skin survival idiom; no literal injury is asserted.
row_decisions.battle.o069b0.p00.l00: His general acceptance of challenges is undercut by today's poor condition and request to postpone until tomorrow, not a completed retreat.

review_batches.context: Clovis finishes critical/defeat chatter, uses ranged/melee/counterattack/special moves, then Fain begins dodge responses. Read 1030-1374 and match the weapon glossary.
review_batches.decisions: Use Baldock, Break Arm, Presion Blast and Gigant Dissolution. Retain threats, close-versus-long-range distinction, repayment/change jokes and the requests to postpone a fight. No byte-budget shortening. Preserve all move-call fragments, pauses, continuations and blanks.

row_decisions.battle.o06a1a.p00.l00: He claims eventual success despite the current course of battle. Keep it as boast, not guaranteed battle result.
row_decisions.battle.o06acb.p00.l00: Of all people, I leaves the source's self-reproach unfinished, without inventing a specific mistake.
row_decisions.battle.o06b17.p00.l00: Explicit death-directed attack taunt preserved as Drop dead.
row_decisions.battle.o06b87.p00.l00: Break Arm matches the source's short name and weapon.156; do not expand every short call to Wired Break Arm.
row_decisions.battle.o06e93.p00.l00: The enemy got inside his guard but misjudged him; later 1178 is the alternative failure to close far enough. Preserve that distinction.
row_decisions.battle.o06ecd.p00.l00: Biting/manners is a training-an-animal metaphor addressed to the opponent, not a new pet or actual bite event.
row_decisions.battle.o06fc1.p00.l00: Keep your change is counterattack sarcasm, linked to repayment with interest, not money actually awarded.
row_decisions.battle.o07064.p00.l01: Gigant Dissolution uses the complete glossary name; no abbreviation for a perceived screen budget.

review_batches.context: Fain's dodge/light-damage boasts, alternating Dusseldorf/Mireon variants, master references and heroic justice rhetoric. Read 1030-1374 with the following severe-damage and retreat lines.
review_batches.decisions: Keep the two machine names as source-dependent alternatives, not spelling variants. Do not name or infer gender for the unnamed master. Preserve justice/courage boasts as character rhetoric, the polish joke and every control/row. Move calls, interjections and intentionally unfinished thoughts remain fragments.

row_decisions.battle.o071fe.p00.l00: Fighting spirit is the ordinary shouted quality here; do not add a stat increase or command execution.
row_decisions.battle.o072ed.p00.l00: Mireon is a different source-dependent machine reference from Dusseldorf. Preserve both rather than normalizing all Fain lines to one mech.
row_decisions.battle.o0731b.p00.l00: The master remains unnamed and no gendered pronoun is required. The opponent is being compared unfavorably to that master.
row_decisions.battle.o0745f.p00.l00: Fain accuses the opponent of uncertainty/hesitation. It is a taunt, not a confirmed psychological state.
row_decisions.battle.o074b0.p00.l00: His I am justice therefore cannot lose reasoning is comic rhetoric; do not turn it into a gameplay immunity claim.
row_decisions.battle.o07568.p00.l01: Defeat isn't in justice's vocabulary localizes the two-Japanese-characters idiom without inventing a false English letter count.
row_decisions.battle.o07678.p00.l00: Bikunai refers to not budging under attack; do not turn it into an immobilization or broken-control complaint.
row_decisions.battle.o07708.p00.l00: Fain delivers a rhetorical soul speech then pretends not to notice an attack; retain that comic turn.

review_batches.context: Fain's Royal Knights/Mireon boast, increasing damage and appeals to Dusseldorf, then defeat reframed as tactical retreat. All 345 context rows 1030-1374 examined.
review_batches.decisions: Keep official standard mech role, knightly resolve, master/disciple connection, separate machine appeals and the contrast between powerless justice and power without justice. Retain temporary disgrace/faith logic and retreat to win, without asserting death. All controls, empty timing rows and deliberate continuations stay intact.

row_decisions.battle.o0789d.p00.l00: Royal Knights matches the library wording of the formal palace-knights organization. Mireon is its official standard mech, not a royal title for Fain.
row_decisions.battle.o07a2c.p00.l00: Aiming at a gap is called cowardly by Fain. No particular armor joint or unit part is named.
row_decisions.battle.o07a8c.p00.l00: My master never gives up leads to Fain affirming his discipleship. Keep the unidentified master's gender and name unspecified.
row_decisions.battle.o07ad3.p00.l00: Fain addresses Dusseldorf and asks it not to fall; the machine is not telling him to surrender.
row_decisions.battle.o07b50.p00.l00: Armor breaking apart is minimized by Fain's boast that they can still fight; do not claim the whole mech is unharmed.
row_decisions.battle.o07c07.p00.l00: Endure it is his own shouted resolve, not an order to the opponent to stay still.
row_decisions.battle.o07d66.p00.l00: Preserve both halves: justice lacking power versus power lacking justice, and his refusal to bow to the latter.
row_decisions.battle.o07dfa.p00.l00: Keep the whole light/darkness paradox and promise to dispel darkness, as Fain's metaphor rather than a physical environment description.
row_decisions.battle.o07f04.p00.l00: He denies defeat and says he yields victory temporarily; don't replace the comic rationalization with an unqualified win or death.
row_decisions.battle.o07f3f.p00.l00: Temporary disgrace plus retaining faith is a condition, continued across the next page's promise to shine. Preserve the logic and all rows.

review_batches.context: Fain's remaining retreat/defeat responses, melee/ranged/counter calls and first Vial Jade variants. Read physical rows 1350-1699, including Gen's complete record and the next pilot's opening context.
review_batches.decisions: Keep Dusseldorf versus Mireon references, Rest Jin Benish's full title/name, honor/justice boasts, explicit slicing threat and Esgion Missile/Vial Jade names. Maintain all control bytes, blanks and row boundaries. Interjections, formal self-introduction, shouted move calls and unfinished thoughts retain source fragments.

row_decisions.battle.o07fbc.p00.l00: Today is the opponent's victory, with a promise that Fain will change tomorrow; do not make it an immediate victory for Fain.
row_decisions.battle.o080dc.p00.l00: Burned out is his exhausted-fire metaphor; no death, actual burning body or destroyed engine is asserted.
row_decisions.battle.o08298.p00.l00: Formal introduction gives Rest Jin Benish, Phoenix Knight, as Fain's master, and Fain's full name as the first disciple on the next row. Keep the intentional introductory fragment.
row_decisions.battle.o08377.p00.l00: Explicit slice-you-into-rounds threat preserved without softening or adding a graphic outcome.
row_decisions.battle.o083c4.p00.l00: Draw blades/charge is a stylized attack call, not a claim about a counted number of swords physically present.
row_decisions.battle.o08474.p00.l00: Fain complains that ranged controls are troublesome, not that the weapon has failed or run out of ammunition.
row_decisions.battle.o08574.p00.l00: Thanks refers ironically to repaying an attack; preserve the knightly courtesy joke.
row_decisions.battle.o085fc.p00.l00: One blow, one kill preserves lethal finishing-move rhetoric; it is not a guaranteed gameplay result.
row_decisions.battle.o08696.p00.l00: Stretched hissa is a shouted finishing-move announcement, localized as stretched English words rather than untranslated prose.

review_batches.context: Fain finishes Vial Jade and Voltic Lancer variants, followed by Rosalie's development placeholder and Gen's opening dodge/damage responses. All 350 rows 1350-1699 examined.
review_batches.decisions: Use full glossary attack names even in long calls, retaining stretched vowels as delivery. Preserve distinct one-kill versus one-knockdown rhetoric, Rosalie placeholder without inventing speech, Gen's childlike boasts and appeals to his sister. All formatting, blank timing rows and deliberate fragments remain.

row_decisions.battle.o087cb.p00.l00: Two-line heroic verse retains blood/fire and justice-blade imagery, not a new ability effect or a claim of an actual bleeding wound.
row_decisions.battle.o08872.p00.l00: The move is explicitly taught directly by the master here; do not confuse it with Gen's more ambiguous Xiujian attribution later.
row_decisions.battle.o0897c.p00.l00: One shot, one flash is an editorial rendering of the compact arrow/flash call; do not invent a separately selectable technique.
row_decisions.battle.o089e1.p00.l00: Bring you down differs from the earlier one-kill boast; retain the less specific defeat wording.
row_decisions.battle.o08a6f.p00.l00: Heaven's punishment is a character's knightly flourish, not a newly named deity or faction.
row_decisions.battle.o08ada.p00.l00: One-word development placeholder, like Ymir's earlier record. Preserve the readable label and control; do not invent finished Rosalie battle dialogue or claim runtime use.
row_decisions.battle.o08c0b.p00.l00: Sis refers to Gen's established sister Rosalie, but keep the source's address rather than inserting an unspoken name.

review_batches.context: Gen's damage/critical/defeat responses and first Zeulear call. Read 1350-1699 with the surrounding machine/sister references.
review_batches.decisions: Keep four musical notes, fire and power-drop details, fear of sister's scolding/removal, separate sister/big-bro/Celica addresses, uncertainty versus actual defeat and explicit running away to fight tomorrow. Preserve every source row and control; do not supply a death or exact damage level.

row_decisions.battle.o08de2.p00.l00: Exactly four music-note symbols retained; native font support remains pending.
row_decisions.battle.o08ed0.p00.l00: Gen says he messed up, a self-assessment, not praise that the enemy completed a task.
row_decisions.battle.o08f3b.p00.l00: Apology addresses Zeifon and blames Gen's skill. Do not reverse who is apologizing to whom.
row_decisions.battle.o08fc9.p00.l00: Power has dropped slightly, but Gen thinks he can manage; no exact fuel/HP percentage or guaranteed survival added.
row_decisions.battle.o0909f.p00.l01: Being scolded if he breaks the machine is conditional, not a statement that Rosalie owns or has already punished him for it.
row_decisions.battle.o09118.p00.l00: Another hit might defeat him. Preserve the possibility rather than asserting death or a numerical one-hit game rule.
row_decisions.battle.o09144.p00.l01: His plea invokes being a child; do not erase his age-based protest or invent an exact age.
row_decisions.battle.o091f4.p00.l01: Sister may remove him from piloting if he keeps fighting poorly. No permanent ban or prior removal is stated.
row_decisions.battle.o0932b.p00.l00: Big bro is a familiar older-boy address; no biological brother is invented. Celica's named Big Sis address follows separately and does not make her Rosalie.
row_decisions.battle.o093ea.p00.l00: He explicitly runs away for tomorrow; retain the comic retreat rather than recasting it as death or a successful counterattack.
row_decisions.battle.o09474.p00.l00: Zeulear Crash is Gen's spoken attack call, with Mighty Sword title echoed afterward; do not add a separate menu entry without evidence.

review_batches.context: Gen's melee/ranged/counterattack and Second Blade: Dragon Slayer variants, ending before Aurelie's record. Read 1350-1699 and check named weapons against glossary.
review_batches.decisions: Keep Raucrus, full Second Blade name, joke moves explicitly retracted, Xiujian attribution without guessing whether the source means naming or instruction, the one-stroke denial and payment/interest jokes. Preserve all controls, empty rows and intentionally incomplete boasts. No shortening for byte or pixel fit.

row_decisions.battle.o0954a.p00.l00: Super Peerless Slash is explicitly retracted as a joke in the same line, not a confirmed gameplay ability.
row_decisions.battle.o0956c.p00.l00: He jokes with the real Second Blade move name here, but later serious variants retain it too. Keep just kidding locally without globally treating the move as fictitious.
row_decisions.battle.o09669.p00.l00: Built-in weapons hurt if they hit is his taunt; no specific penetration or damage formula is added.
row_decisions.battle.o097bd.p00.l00: Source tsukete moratta leaves whether Xiujian named or taught the move unclear. I owe this move to Xiujian preserves attribution without selecting an unsupported mechanism; retain for meaning review.
row_decisions.battle.o09828.p00.l01: Zeulear's bad mood personifies the sword; do not invent a sentient-weapon lore claim.
row_decisions.battle.o0988e.p00.l00: Affected swordsman line is immediately retracted as a joke, then followed by a real threat. Keep all three parts and the incomplete/parodic delivery.
row_decisions.battle.o0990d.p00.l00: Gen denies that the multi-strike move is needed because he cannot cut in one stroke. Do not reverse the denial into an admission.
row_decisions.battle.o09942.p00.l00: Everything I've got is an intentionally fragmentary pre-attack vow, continued by the next row's full move call.
row_decisions.battle.o09942.p00.l01: Two-Blade Combo follows the source's nitou wording as a call, not verified visual evidence of two physical swords. Do not change it to a generic two-hit attack.
row_decisions.battle.o09a0d.p00.l00: Double payback and interest both retained, followed by Gen's business boast, fitting his shop background.
row_decisions.battle.o09aac.p00.l00: Too late to apologize is an attack taunt; no actual apology by the enemy is invented.

review_batches.context: Aurelie's dodge through severe-damage alternatives. Read physical rows 1670-2109, including the neighboring Gen/Arthur/Melvi spans and later story background for her return-to-the-kids vow.
review_batches.decisions: Preserve Parikar mobility, damage uncertainty, taunts versus self-criticism, output drop, threat to attack seriously and no named body injury. Keep every format control and timing blank. Intentional source fragments, interjections, incomplete thoughts and row continuations remain intact.

row_decisions.battle.o09ba1.p00.l00: Apology is sarcastic after dodging automatically, not regret that she attacked an ally.
row_decisions.battle.o09d86.p00.l00: Deliberately unfinished attack-skill criticism; no omitted conclusion invented.
row_decisions.battle.o09e79.p00.l00: Giving me a workout carries her recognition that the opponent can hit; it is not a literal training-session confirmation.
row_decisions.battle.o09f01.p00.l00: Bad hit location remains nonspecific; don't name a pilot injury or machine subsystem.
row_decisions.battle.o09f7b.p00.l00: Her emphasis on mobility has backfired. Do not invent numerical armor/speed tradeoffs beyond the source.
row_decisions.battle.o0a009.p00.l00: Attack missed a vital spot; preserve that rather than saying Aurelie aimed and missed someone else's vital spot.
row_decisions.battle.o0a0b5.p00.l00: She asks whether she failed to dodge fully, then judges accumulated damage. No certainty of a fully avoided hit.
row_decisions.battle.o0a0e2.p00.l00: Little nibbles localizes repeated small attacks, not a new biting enemy.
row_decisions.battle.o0a106.p00.l00: Output dropping remains a question with no exact percentage or cause supplied.
row_decisions.battle.o0a17b.p00.l00: She challenges the enemy to strike as though sinking her in one hit; not an admission that one hit must necessarily kill her.
row_decisions.battle.o0a285.p00.l00: Later story s_1a3 says she grew up in an orphanage and plays for its children, explicitly not her own. Those kids is consistent with that background, without adding biological motherhood or their names to this line.

review_batches.context: Aurelie's critical-damage, orphanage-return vows, ejection, melee/ranged/counterattack calls and resolve about killing. All 440 rows 1670-2109 examined; story s_1a3 explicitly identifies orphanage children as not her biological children.
review_batches.decisions: Keep return-to-kids and Big Sis addresses without inventing motherhood, suicidal last-stand contemplation distinct from actual death, explicit ejection, full Laser Sword call and unsoftened killing/ruthlessness. Preserve all controls, blanks, fragments and hard physical rows.

row_decisions.battle.o0a326.p00.l00: Big Sis is her affectionate self-address to those awaiting her return. It does not establish that all are biological siblings.
row_decisions.battle.o0a373.p00.l00: Gyokusai has fatal last-stand force, unlike ordinary retreat or taking damage. Keep suicidal last stand as contemplation, not confirmed death or an actual charge motion.
row_decisions.battle.o0a3ec.p00.l00: Her denial of damage is defiant speech, not a mechanical immunity guarantee.
row_decisions.battle.o0a4a0.p00.l00: Screaming parts personify the damaged machine; the following endurance request addresses it, not an injured passenger.
row_decisions.battle.o0a555.p00.l00: Explicit ejection, kept separate from the next alternative's withdrawal.
row_decisions.battle.o0a870.p00.l00: Prey is an aiming metaphor aimed at the enemy, not an actual animal hunting scene.
row_decisions.battle.o0a96d.p00.l00: In counterattack context, yatta ne is a reproach for what the opponent did; Now you've done it avoids making it a celebration of their hit. Retain for meaning review if runtime delivery differs.
row_decisions.battle.o0aa33.p00.l00: Keep the explicit possibility of taking a life by her own hand and refusal to flee. No euphemistic merely hurt substitution.
row_decisions.battle.o0aa78.p00.l00: No good or evil in battle and resolve to be ruthless are Aurelie's moral claims, not narrator endorsements.

review_batches.context: Aurelie's Noir Eclair calls finish; Arthur begins dodge/light-damage responses and criticism of relying on machines. Read all 440 rows 1670-2109, including neighboring severe damage and attacks.
review_batches.decisions: Use Noir Eclair/Drydes names, preserve feint advice and false-eyes imagery without inventing a specific device, and distinguish his own missed dodge from criticism of enemy skill. Where condition subject remains unresolved, use an impersonal full English clause and flag it. Controls, timing blanks and all row boundaries retained.

row_decisions.battle.o0aaef.p00.l00: Boldly yet delicately is an intentional contrast in her delivery, not a named new mode.
row_decisions.battle.o0abd0.p00.l00: Lightning's embrace is attack imagery accompanying Noir Eclair, not a new separately evidenced weapon.
row_decisions.battle.o0ad53.p00.l00: Hospitality is a sarcastic metaphor for the opponent's attack; preserve the polite refusal.
row_decisions.battle.o0ad84.p00.l00: Arthur says he dodged too early and criticizes his own training, not the opponent's timing.
row_decisions.battle.o0adb2.p00.l00: False eyes versus own eyes is his contrast. Do not invent cybernetic eyes, a specific display system or actual blindness.
row_decisions.battle.o0ae52.p00.l00: That backfired leaves the exact failed tactic unspecified, as does the source.
row_decisions.battle.o0aeb0.p00.l00: Almost there is a taunt about the opponent's effort, followed by asking whether it is their limit.
row_decisions.battle.o0af75.p00.l00: The source does not settle whose condition is off: his own performance or the opponent's. Something seems to be off retains the uncertainty with a full English subject/verb; keep for meaning/runtime delivery review.
row_decisions.battle.o0b0bf.p00.l00: Mastering a tool versus merely using it is Arthur's distinction; do not reverse it into praise for the opponent's mastery.
row_decisions.battle.o0b129.p00.l00: Arthur admits armor saved him while warning against relying on it. Do not make his judgment refer solely to the opponent's armor.
row_decisions.battle.o0b15d.p00.l00: He revises sluggish response into possible personal hesitation, not a confirmed mechanical fault.

review_batches.context: Arthur's increasing damage, moral criticism, predator/throat warning and refusal to fall. All 440 context rows examined.
review_batches.decisions: Preserve praise turning to criticism, his own misjudgment, fields/people/self destruction list, direct violent metaphor, and conditional power/grief statements. Moral claims remain his dialogue. Keep every control, intentional fragment, multi-page speech and empty timing row without shortening.

row_decisions.battle.o0b284.p00.l00: Praise for prediction/accuracy is deliberately undercut as too perfect and dull. No confirmed automatic targeting mechanism is added.
row_decisions.battle.o0b314.p00.l00: Arthur recognizes his own misjudgment; don't reverse the subject into the opponent admitting error.
row_decisions.battle.o0b415.p00.l00: He would like to dismiss the wounds as scratches but admits he cannot. Keep the self-correction rather than declaring only superficial damage.
row_decisions.battle.o0b455.p00.l00: Polite request that the opponent stop attacking is followed by recognizing they will not; do not reverse it into an offer that Arthur stop fighting.
row_decisions.battle.o0b4c1.p00.l00: Fields means farmland here, not battlefield alone. The destruction list is a deliberately fragmentary object list governed by destroys in the preceding row.
row_decisions.battle.o0b522.p00.l00: Halfhearted attacks shorten the attacker's own life, according to Arthur. Keep the possessive across the hard row split; don't assign the shortened life to Arthur instead.
row_decisions.battle.o0b568.p00.l00: Enjoying battle is posed as a question then condemned; keep the insult without narrating the target's actual inner feelings.
row_decisions.battle.o0b5df.p00.l00: Arthur's many received hits lead him to consider changing his own tactics, not instructing the enemy to change theirs.
row_decisions.battle.o0b684.p00.l00: Deliberately unfinished damage assessment; no invented conclusion about defeat or death.
row_decisions.battle.o0b6ad.p00.l00: Keep the whole predatory warning across pages: prey must stop breathing before release, or the attacker's own throat may be bitten through. These are Arthur's threats, not a narrated graphic injury.
row_decisions.battle.o0b6ad.p03.l00: Arthur identifies himself as targeting that throat in the next row. Do not soften the warning into merely be careful.
row_decisions.battle.o0b769.p00.l00: Opponent's destructive power leads Arthur to contemplate pushing himself; no new named risky technique or numeric power level is supplied.
row_decisions.battle.o0b7b2.p00.l00: His vow lasts until the source spreading sorrow is defeated. No specific antagonist identity is named here.
row_decisions.battle.o0b7ec.p00.l00: Power is morally neutral versus this opponent's sorrow-spreading use is his stated distinction; preserve both clauses.

review_batches.context: Arthur's near-limit, retreat/ejection and attack/counterattack/special-power calls, ending with a chosen demon-of-battle metaphor. Read 1670-2109, including his final following span and Melvi's opening context.
review_batches.decisions: Keep mutual defeat distinct from guaranteed death, explicit ejection and handoff direction, full Heavenly Dance, Sky Rend/Plasma Cannon names, manual aiming states, leg-aim preference and the conflict between nonviolence and fighting. Preserve all source controls and rows; deliberate move-call fragments and interrupted vows remain.

row_decisions.battle.o0b8f2.p00.l00: Going down together retains mutual defeat/takedown intent; the source does not require a confirmed mutual death.
row_decisions.battle.o0b919.p00.l00: One more hit is his spoken limit assessment, not proof of an exact game HP threshold.
row_decisions.battle.o0b93b.p00.l00: Retreat/advance question is rhetorical; do not turn it into an extra player-choice menu.
row_decisions.battle.o0b9e0.p00.l00: He asks the remaining allies to handle the rest after withdrawal/ejection, not offers to do it himself.
row_decisions.battle.o0bbaa.p00.l00: Attack-category context supports Arthur trying the attack himself, not a demand that the opponent perform an experiment.
row_decisions.battle.o0bbf0.p00.l00: Medium-range conditional deliberately trails off; do not add a guaranteed-hit conclusion.
row_decisions.battle.o0bc39.p00.l00: Aiming adjustment, manual mode, target acquisition and fire are intentionally clipped operational state calls, not omitted subjects in narrative prose.
row_decisions.battle.o0bcc6.p00.l00: He would prefer to aim at the legs but says the situation denies that luxury. No actual severed limb or completed disabling shot is stated.
row_decisions.battle.o0bd18.p00.l00: Purpose clause precedes his vow to become a warrior; retain the two-row continuation.
row_decisions.battle.o0bd52.p00.l00: Arthur acknowledges revenge breeding conflict yet deliberately chooses it. Do not sanitize that moral conflict into uncomplicated righteous action.
row_decisions.battle.o0be0a.p00.l00: He says he will himself sow conflict through retaliation. Keep the self-implication rather than blaming only the enemy.
